notes.title: Language and Controls fix - Patch v1.02
notes.content:
Dear Cult Leaders,

We’ve just released update v1.02, which focuses on quality-of-life improvements:

Changes in this version:


 Fixed issues with loading certain languages (Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Korean, and Thai).

Improved control settings:


[] smoother camera sensitivity adjustment,
[] improved scroll handling.


This is a small but important step that should make the gameplay experience more comfortable for both new and returning players.

Thank you for all your reports and support 🙏

See you in the next patches!
Nhneno

notes.title: Hotfix v1.01 - Language Display Fix (Chinese Simplified & Traditional)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released a small but important hotfix (v1.01) that fixes missing characters in the Chinese Simplified and Chinese Traditional versions of the game. Text should now display correctly in both languages across all menus and gameplay.

Thanks to everyone who reported this issue - your feedback helps me improve quickly!

Let me know if you spot anything else, and enjoy the game!

Nhneno <3

notes.title: We're launching in one week!
notes.content:
Only one week left until the gates of Cult Leader Simulator officially open!


Mark your calendars: August 1st is the day you’ll finally be able to unleash your inner visionary (or con artist) and lead your followers to glorious, weird enlightenment.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597385/ad4713f99246dca625d1c0c28bfd1c3e7ec89546.gif"]



The full version brings massive improvements and new features beyond what you saw in the demo, including:


🔴 Story-driven Missions with Surprises and… Consequences


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597385/5597dbee6248d96af20d261e8d711695019cfd85.gif"]


🔴 Helpful Coins with Unique and Powerful Bonuses


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597385/41c12a61e6d5fcdecdb95d0ff47e4f49f0559709.gif"]


🔴 Improved Balance, Polish and Flavor


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597385/d239cd3ea698c3c3954a636fc0f1f3ddc5494b3f.gif"]



So… prepare your hooded robes and stock up on tinfoil. One week to go.


Wishlist Cult Leader Simulator!

notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597385/a41e400a0b993e9a9a8504ffbd028306c88044b3.jpg"]ㅤ
Dear Cult Leaders,
ㅤ
The time has come.

The Cult Leader Simulator Demo is officially live and ready for your divine guidance.

In this early version of the game, you will take the first steps towards building a powerful organization. Use strategic cards to manipulate the masses, manage resources, evade law enforcement, and expand your influence across the fictional United States. Whether you seek power, enlightenment, alien contact, or something darker, your path begins now. 



 What's in the demo?

A snippet of the full game with key mechanics

Deck building and strategic card placement

Regional modifiers that affect your every move

Dynamic feedback system: watch your influence, police interest, and followers grow or crumble

 Feedback!

Help shape the future of the game

Let me know which career path suits your cult the best

Be among the first to conquer states and test different strategies



Build your cult. Spread your truth. Dominate the map.

Try out the demo today and let me know what you think. Your followers are waiting!
